questions.stem: If a line has direction ratios 2, -1, -2, what are its direction cosines?
questions.solution: The direction cosines are given by dividing the direction ratios by the magnitude of the direction ratios. The magnitude is √(2² + (-1)² + (-2)²) = √(4 + 1 + 4) = √9 = 3. So the direction cosines are 2/3, -1/3, -2/3. The other options use incorrect magnitudes or do not simplify the square root properly.

hi.stem: यदि एक रेखा के दिशा अनुपात 2, -1, -2 हैं, तो इसके दिशा कोज्या क्या हैं?
hi.solution: दिशा कोज्या दिशा अनुपातों के मापांक द्वारा विभाजित करके दिये जाते हैं। मापांक √(2² + (-1)² + (-2)²) = √(4 + 1 + 4) = √9 = 3 है। इसलिए दिशा कोज्या 2/3, -1/3, -2/3 हैं। अन्य विकल्प गलत मापांक का उपयोग करते हैं या वर्गमूल को सही तरह से सरल नहीं करते।

mr.solution: दिशा कोसाइन म्हणजे दिशा अनुपाताला दिशा अनुपाताच्या परिमाणाने भागून मिळतात. परिमाण हे √(2² + (-1)² + (-2)²) = √(4 + 1 + 4) = √9 = 3 आहे. म्हणून दिशा कोसाइन 2/3, -1/3, -2/3 असतात. इतर पर्यायांमध्ये चुकीचे परिमाण वापरले गेले आहे किंवा वर्गमूळ योग्यरित्या सोपे केले गेले नाही.
mr.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the mathematical meaning, and uses appropriate Marathi terminology for direction ratios and direction cosines.

questions.stem: What is the significance of the cross product of the direction vectors in finding the shortest distance between two skew lines?
choices: It gives the direction of the shortest distance line between the two skew lines
It gives the magnitude of the shortest distance between the two skew lines
It gives the area of the parallelogram formed by the direction vectors
It gives the angle between the two skew lines
questions.solution: The cross product of the direction vectors of two skew lines gives a vector that is perpendicular to both lines, which is the direction of the shortest distance line between the two skew lines. The other options describe different properties of the cross product or are not directly related to the shortest distance calculation.

questions.stem: If a line makes angles α, β, γ with the x, y, and z-axes respectively, and the direction cosines are l, m, n, which of the following equations must always be true?
questions.solution: The direction cosines of a line satisfy the equation l² + m² + n² = 1, as they represent the cosines of the angles the line makes with the coordinate axes and are derived from the unit vector in the direction of the line. The other options do not represent the correct property of direction cosines.

hi.stem: यदि एक रेखा x, y, और z-अक्षों के साथ क्रमशः कोण α, β, γ बनाती है, और दिशा कोज्या l, m, n हैं, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा समीकरण हमेशा सत्य होना चाहिए?
hi.solution: एक रेखा की दिशा कोज्या समीकरण l² + m² + n² = 1 को संतुष्ट करती है, क्योंकि वे रेखा द्वारा निर्देशांक अक्षों के साथ बने कोणों के कोज्या होते हैं और रेखा की दिशा में इकाई सदिश से निकाले जाते हैं। अन्य विकल्प दिशा कोज्या के सही गुण का प्रतिनिधित्व नहीं करते हैं।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses standard mathematical terminology as taught in Hindi-medium textbooks.

questions.stem: If a line has direction ratios 1, 2, 3 and another line has direction ratios 2, 4, 6, what can be said about these two lines?
questions.solution: The direction ratios of the second line (2, 4, 6) are exactly twice the direction ratios of the first line (1, 2, 3), which means the lines are parallel. The other options are incorrect because the lines have proportional direction ratios, indicating parallelism, not perpendicularity or other relationships.

hi.solution: दूसरी रेखा के दिशा अनुपात (2, 4, 6) पहली रेखा के दिशा अनुपात (1, 2, 3) के बिल्कुल दोगुने हैं, जिसका अर्थ है कि रेखाएं समांतर हैं। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि रेखाओं के दिशा अनुपात समानुपाती हैं, जो समांतरता को दर्शाते हैं, न कि लंबवतता या अन्य संबंधों को।

questions.stem: What is the shortest distance between two skew lines?
choices: The distance between their points of intersection
The perpendicular distance between the two lines
The length of the line segment joining any two points on the lines
The distance between their direction ratios
questions.solution: The shortest distance between two skew lines is the perpendicular distance between the two lines. This is because skew lines are neither parallel nor intersecting, and the shortest distance between them is the length of the line segment that is perpendicular to both lines. The other options are incorrect as they do not describe the correct method for finding the shortest distance between skew lines.
